preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100.
The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two nodes labeled between 1 and n in your labeling.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= k_1 <= n and all(1 <= x_i <= n for x_i in your_subtree)
preconditions.description: Your subtree has between 1 and n nodes, all labeled between 1 and n in your labeling.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= k_2 <= n and all(1 <= y_i <= n for y_i in li_chens_subtree)
preconditions.description: Li Chen's subtree has between 1 and n nodes, all labeled between 1 and n in his labeling.
The lengths of your_subtree and li_chens_subtree match k_1 and k_2, respectively.

preconditions.expression: all(x != y for x in your_subtree for y in your_subtree if x != y)
preconditions.description: Your subtree nodes are distinct in your labeling.

preconditions.expression: all(y != z for y in li_chens_subtree for z in li_chens_subtree if y != z)
preconditions.description: Li Chen's subtree nodes are distinct in his labeling.

postconditions.expression: any(common_node in your_subtree for common_node in intersection)
postconditions.description: If there exists a common node between your subtree and Li Chen's subtree, the output is one of your labels for such a node.
The output is either -1 (no common node) or a valid node label from your subtree.
The number of questions asked to Andrew is at most 5.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for question in questions if question.startswith('A') and (x := int(question.split()[1])))
postconditions.description: Each 'A x' question has x between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= y <= n for question in questions if question.startswith('B') and (y := int(question.split()[1])))
postconditions.description: Each 'B y' question has y between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output in your_subtree and any(andrew_mapping[output] in li_chens_subtree for andrew_mapping in possible_mappings))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, it is a valid common node based on the possible mappings inferred from questions.
